title: Soft Drink, Fruit Flavored, Caffeine Containing

content.title: About
content.content: A fruit‑flavored soft drink with caffeine is a refreshing non‑alcoholic beverage that combines natural fruit extracts, sugar (or sweeteners) and caffeine for a mild stimulant effect. These drinks are popular as a lighter‑tasting alternative to colas and energy drinks, offering a crisp fruit profile.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Fruit flavorings are often derived from real juices but may be enhanced with synthetic compounds for consistency.
Caffeine levels typically range from 30 to 80 mg per 330 ml can, lower than a standard cup of coffee.
The first fruit‑flavored carbonated drink appeared in the late 19th century during experiments with flavored soda water.
In some countries these beverages are classified as “energy drinks,” requiring special labeling.
Packaging usually features bright colors to highlight the fruity character.

items.title: Improved focus
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, enhancing alertness and reaction time.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Carbonated water contributes to daily fluid intake when consumed in moderation.

items.title: Vitamin contribution
items.content: Fruit extracts can provide small amounts of vitamin C and antioxidants.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: The combination of sugar (or sweeteners) and caffeine delivers a quick rise in energy levels.

items.title: Mood uplift
items.content: Sweet taste and pleasant aroma may temporarily improve mood.

items.title: Excess caffeine
items.content: Too much caffeine can cause anxiety, insomnia, and rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: High sugar intake raises the risk of cavities, weight gain, and metabolic disorders.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The acidic nature of carbonated drinks can irritate the stomach lining and erode tooth enamel.

items.title: Allergic reactions
items.content: Some flavoring agents may trigger individual sensitivities.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Serve the fruit‑flavored soft drink chilled, preferably in moderate amounts (no more than 1‑2 cans per day). It can be used as a base for cocktails, mixed with juices, or incorporated into recipes such as marinades.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the beverage in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, store it in the refrigerator and consume within 3‑5 days to maintain carbonation and flavor.
